title: Isolate the direct queue durability hold nonce in receipt tests
outcome: Distinguish the queued-content hold nonce from the primary delivery write-ahead UUID in the durable proof and owner-change controls.
acceptance: Behavior tests change only the durability hold nonce with content and delivery write-ahead intact. The durable row fence refuses the mismatch, and a change after proof rolls back the coordination evidence. The separate write-ahead mismatch remains covered.
